/** locgov-mapper.getLocgovCountByParam (지자체관리 목록 총 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_LOCGOV L
ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/** locgov-mapper.getLocgovDetails (지자체관리 상세 정보 조회) */ SELECT A.locgov_code, A.upper_locgov_nm, A.locgov_nm, A.upper_locgov_code, A.locgov_intrcn_cn, A.charger_cttpc as charger_cttpc, A.charger_nm as charger_nm, A.charger_email, A.charger_psitn_dept, A.locgov_hmpg, A.locgov_popltn_co, A.locgov_ar, A.locgov_spcprd, A.gcct_use_at, A.etrcsh_use_at, A.use_at, A.locgov_budget_amt, A.bizrno, A.locgov_zip, A.bass_adres, A.dtl_adres, A.achlqr_sle_at, A.frst_register_id, A.frst_regist_pnttm, A.last_updusr_id, A.last_updt_pnttm, A.point_rate, A.process_dept_code, A.administ_instt_code, A.stdr_1level_amt, A.stdr_2level_amt, A.stdr_3level_amt, A.lmtt_bgn_de, A.lmtt_end_de, A.violt_resn_cn, A.offcs_nm, A.offcs_file_nm, A.orginl_file_nm, A.fis_sp FROM ( SELECT L.locgov_code, L.upper_locgov_nm, L.locgov_nm, L.upper_locgov_code, L.locgov_intrcn_cn, L.charger_cttpc, L.charger_nm, CASE WHEN L.charger_email IS NULL OR L.charger_email = '' THEN (SELECT email FROM op_manager WHERE locgov_code = L.locgov_code and user_name = L.charger_nm LIMIT 1) ELSE L.charger_email END AS charger_email, L.charger_psitn_dept, L.locgov_hmpg, L.locgov_popltn_co, L.locgov_ar, L.locgov_spcprd, L.gcct_use_at, L.etrcsh_use_at, L.use_at, L.locgov_budget_amt, L.bizrno, L.locgov_zip, L.bass_adres, L.dtl_adres, L.achlqr_sle_at, L.frst_register_id, DATE_FORMAT(L.frst_regist_pnttm,'%Y-%m-%d') AS frst_regist_pnttm, L.last_updusr_id, DATE_FORMAT(L.last_updt_pnttm,'%Y-%m-%d') AS last_updt_pnttm, ( SELECT point_rate FROM g_ctbny_setup WHERE locgov_code = L.locgov_code AND stdr_year = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y') ) AS point_rate, L.process_dept_code, L.administ_instt_code, L.stdr_1level_amt, L.stdr_2level_amt, L.stdr_3level_amt, CL.lmtt_bgn_de, CL.lmtt_end_de, CL.violt_resn_cn, L.offcs_nm, L.offcs_file_nm, L.orginl_file_nm, L.fis_sp FROM g_locgov L LEFT OUTER JOIN g_cntr_lmtt CL ON L.locgov_code = CL.locgov_code WHERE L.locgov_code = #{locgovCode} )A
mapper.insert:
/** locgov-mapper.insertContributionSetup (기부금 설정 등록) */ INSERT INTO G_CTBNY_SETUP ( STDR_YEAR, LOCGOV_CODE, LMT_AMT, POINT_RATE, POINT_VALID_PD, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{stdrYear}, #{locgovCode}, #{lmtAmt}, #{pointRate}, #{pointValidPd}, #{frstRegisterId}, , #{lastUpdusrId},
)
mapper.select: /** locgov-mapper.getLoginUserLocgovCodeDetails (로그인 사용자 지자체 코드 상세 정보) */ SELECT C.CODE_TYPE, C.LANGUAGE, C.ID, CONCAT(IFNULL(( SELECT CONCAT(SC.LABEL, ' ') FROM OP_COMMON_CODE SC WHERE SC.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(C.ID, 1, 2), '000') AND SC.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND SC.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND SC.USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ), ''), C.LABEL) AS LABEL, C.DETAIL, C.ORDERING, C.USE_YN, C.UP_ID, C.CODE_VALUE, C.EXTENSION_CODE, C.MAPPING_CODE FROM OP_COMMON_CODE C INNER JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.LOCGOV_CODE = C.ID WHERE C.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'

/** locgov-mapper.getContributionSetupDetails (기부금 설정 상세 조회) */ SELECT CS.STDR_YEAR, CS.LOCGOV_CODE, CS.LMT_AMT, CS.POINT_RATE, CS.POINT_VALID_PD, CS.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CS.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, CS.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CS.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, (SELECT USER_NAME FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE USER_ID = CS.LAST_UPDUSR_ID) AS LAST_UPDUSR_NAME FROM G_CTBNY_SETUP CS WHERE CS.STDR_YEAR = #{stdrYear} AND CS.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}
mapper.update: /** locgov-mapper.updateLocgov (지자체 수정) */ UPDATE G_LOCGOV SET LOCGOV_INTRCN_CN = #{locgovIntrcnCn}, CHARGER_CTTPC = #{chargerCttpc}, CHARGER_NM = #{chargerNm}, CHARGER_EMAIL = #{chargerEmail}, CHARGER_PSITN_DEPT = #{chargerPsitnDept}, LOCGOV_HMPG = #{locgovHmpg}, LOCGOV_POPLTN_CO = #{locgovPopltnCo}, LOCGOV_BUDGET_AMT = #{locgovBudgetAmt}, BIZRNO = #{bizrno}, LOCGOV_ZIP = #{locgovZip}, BASS_ADRES = #{bassAdres}, DTL_ADRES = #{dtlAdres}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = , PROCESS_DEPT_CODE = #{processDeptCode}, ADMINIST_INSTT_CODE = #{administInsttCode}, STDR_1LEVEL_AMT = nvl(#{stdr1levelAmt}, 0), STDR_2LEVEL_AMT = nvl(#{stdr2levelAmt}, 0), STDR_3LEVEL_AMT = nvl(#{stdr3levelAmt}, 0), OFFCS_NM = #{offcsNm}, OFFCS_FILE_NM = #{offcsFileNm}, ORGINL_FILE_NM = #{orginlFileNm}, FIS_SP = #{fisSp} WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}
mapper.delete: UPDATE G_LOCGOV SET STDR_1LEVEL_AMT = 0, STDR_2LEVEL_AMT = 0, STDR_3LEVEL_AMT = 0
mapper.insert:
/** locgov-mapper.insertCntrLmtt (기부 제한 등록) */ INSERT INTO G_CNTR_LMTT( LMTT_BGN_DE, LMTT_END_DE, LOCGOV_CODE, VIOLT_RESN_CODE, VIOLT_RESN_CN, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{lmttBgnDe}, #{lmttEndDe}, #{locgovCode}, '100', #{violtResnCn}, #{lastUpdusrId}, , #{lastUpdusrId},
)
mapper.update: /** locgov-mapper.updateCntrLmmt (기부 제한 수정) */ UPDATE G_CNTR_LMTT SET LMTT_BGN_DE = #{lmttBgnDe}, LMTT_END_DE = #{lmttEndDe}, VIOLT_RESN_CN = #{violtResnCn}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}
mapper.select: /** locgov-mapper.getProcessDeptCode (부서 코드 및 명예기부금액 정보 가져오기) */ SELECT PROCESS_DEPT_CODE ,STDR_1LEVEL_AMT ,STDR_2LEVEL_AMT ,STDR_3LEVEL_AMT FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}

/*locgov-mapper.getHonorUserList (명예회원 리스트 가져오기) */ SELECT E.user_id ,E.mber_ci ,E.upper_locgov_nm ,E.locgov_nm ,E.user_name AS user_name ,E.receive_sms FROM ( SELECT A.user_id ,B.mber_ci ,C.upper_locgov_nm ,C.locgov_nm ,B.user_name ,D.receive_sms FROM g_honor_cntrbtr A INNER JOIN op_user B ON A.user_id = B.user_id INNER JOIN g_locgov C ON A.locgov_code = C.locgov_code INNER JOIN op_user_detail D ON B.user_id = D.user_id WHERE A.locgov_code = #{locgovCode} AND A.stdr_year = YEAR(NOW()) )E
